messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning:
The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California, that stay open until at least 10pm (i.e., closing time >= 22). Also want vegan restaurants in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. They didn't specify operating hours for SF and Seattle; maybe default 21? But they might want same criteria? The prompt says "It should find vegan restaurants in LA that stay open until at least 10pm, and also find vegan restaurants in SF and Seattle." It doesn't specify hours for SF/Seattle. We can assume default 21. So we need to call function twice: one for LA with operating_hours=22, and one for SF and Seattle combined? The function expects location string. For SF we can pass "San Francisco, CA". For Seattle "Seattle, WA". We could call function twice: one for LA with operating_hours=22, one for SF with default, and one for Seattle with default. Or combine SF and Seattle into one call? The function only accepts one location string. So we need separate calls.

Thus we will call vegan_restaurant_find_nearby twice: first with location="Los Angeles, CA", operating_hours=22. Second with location="San Francisco, CA" (no operating_hours param). Third with location="Seattle, WA" (no operating_hours param). Then we will output results.

We need to use the function tool. We'll produce three calls.
